scope: Additive clarification of the permanent-hero phase boundary. It changes no catalogue value and enables no combat behavior.
game_version: Consulted public Home Village documentation current on 2026-09-20. The immutable 2026-09-17 reference remains unchanged.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Legacy Hero abilities were separated into replaceable Hero Equipment.
Hero Equipment contains active and passive abilities.
Grand Warden aura is given as an example of a passive ability.
Eternal Tome, Life Gem, Healing Tome, Rage Gem, Royal Gem and Seeking Shield are listed as Hero Equipment.

sources.title: About Heroes & Pets
facts: Home Village has the six Heroes in this phase.
Attacking Heroes are selected into up to four army slots.
Up to four Hero Banners can be placed and defending Heroes patrol around their banner.

scope_findings.finding: Equipment abilities, pets and their interactions are deliberately excluded from this Hero phase. A missing equipment contract is not represented as a missing intrinsic Hero capability.
The observed aura and temporary protection references belong to the excluded Hero Equipment boundary. No unsourced intrinsic aura or protection behavior is enabled.
Seeking Shield is equipment and remains excluded. Wall crossing is independently sourced and remains the only integrated non-equipment special movement behavior.

The official support page establishes banner patrol as a capability but does not publish patrol radius, acquisition, return, respawn, collision or same-tick ordering. Defensive Hero simulation remains explicitly unavailable rather than guessed.

items: source-verified Viewer asset, scale and placement for each Hero

conclusion: The six Heroes have no additional documented non-equipment ability contract in the consulted official sources. The remaining Hero Banner and visual gaps stay explicit and no behavior is inferred from the existence of a Hero or an equipment description.
